## Verification

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] English, Bengali, and Hindi routes were checked
- [ ] Mobile and keyboard behavior were checked when UI changed
- [ ] No secret or `.env` file is included
- [ ] Content changes include official sources
- [ ] Factual changes made after verification were re-verified

## Editorial assets (when images change)

- [ ] Asset is registered in `src/data/editorial-assets.json` with source, licence, AI-use and owner fields
- [ ] No retired brand, third-party logo, official-looking insignia, URL or verification claim is embedded in pixels
- [ ] A human owner reviewed the final 390 px and 1440 px renders and changed `reviewStatus` to `approved-by-owner`
- [ ] Alt text, caption and credit describe the image without overstating verification

## Rollback

Describe the commit, migration, or content revision to restore if this change must be reverted.
